newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine sugar beet planting seen completed soon.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine sugar beet planting seen completed soon.

text.p: Ukrainian farmers have planted 91 percent of the planned sugar beet area and the campaign will be finished in a few days, a senior Agriculture Ministry said on Wednesday.
Valentyn Tymoshenko, deputy head of the crop department, said Ukraine planned to plant 1.218 million hectares with sugar beet compared with 1.3 million hectares last year.

He said 1.114 million hectares had already been planted with sugar beet from 1.295 million hectares at the same time last year. Tymoshenko also said that all crops were growing well and in a good condition.
The ministry expects a sugar beet harvest at around last year's level of 24 million tonnes.
Agriculture Minster Mykhailo Zubets has said that Ukraine plans to gradually reduce its sugar beet area to 800,000-900,000 hectares in the next few years.
